title: In range
prompt: Return true if n is between low and high, including both ends.
signature: func solve(n: int, low: int, high: int) -> bool:
starter:
func solve(n: int, low: int, high: int) -> bool:
	return false
hint: Two conditions joined with `and`: `low <= n and n <= high`.
solution:
func solve(n: int, low: int, high: int) -> bool:
	return low <= n and n <= high
